metadata.title: Lipschitz numbers and fine differentiability on metric measure spaces
metadata.abstract: On a metric space equipped with a doubling measure supporting a Poincaré inequality, we introduce capacity-relaxed infinitesimal Lipschitz numbers and characterize Newtonian functions in $N^{1,p}$, $1\le p\le\infty$, and functions of bounded variation. If $X$ is additionally $Q$-regular, then every BV function is $1$-finely differentiable at $\mu$-almost every point, and its fine differential agrees with its approximate Cheeger differential. We also extend a Sobolev regularity criterion from continuous to $p$-quasicontinuous functions.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在倍增且支持 Poincaré 不等式的度量测度空间，以容量放松的无穷小 Lipschitz 数刻画 Newton–Sobolev 与 BV 函数。
analysis.breakthrough: 覆盖 1≤p≤∞ 的刻画；在额外 Q 正则条件下，BV 函数几乎处处 1-细可微且微分与近似 Cheeger 微分相容。
analysis.limitations: 细可微结论需要额外正则性；不能把细拓扑意义的可微直接改写成普通点态可微。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 为非光滑空间上的一阶分析提供统一而精细的判据。
